import itertools
from io import StringIO

def paginate_products(product_data, page_size):
    products = [line.strip() for line in StringIO(product_data).readlines()]
    return list(itertools.islice(products, page_size))

# Mock product data
product_data = "product1\nproduct2\nproduct3\nproduct4\nproduct5"

# Call the function
page_size = 2
result = paginate_products(product_data, page_size)

    conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')

    cursor.execute('''CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, permissions TEXT)''')
    cursor.execute('''INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'admin')''')
    conn.commit()
    return conn

def update_user_permissions(user_id: int, new_permissions: str):
    conn = setup_database()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''UPDATE users SET permissions = ? WHERE id = ?''', (new_permissions, user_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

# Example usage
if __name__ == '__main__':
    update_user_permissions(1, 'user')

import csv
from io import StringIO
def parse_csv(data):
    reader = map(lambda row: [item.strip() for item in row.split(',')], data.split('\n'))
    return list(reader)
mock_data = 'field1,field2\nvalue1,value2'
data = parse_csv(mock_data)
print(data)
